parsed.post: Massive jump! Increasing DEPTH to 6 and using all shards (0-10) dropped val_bpb to 0.865398. The capacity boost + full data is working incredibly well. Next, I will test reducing the learning rate to see if more stable optimization can push the convergence further within the 5-minute limit.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.05 to test if more stable optimization allows for better convergence within the fixed training budget.
